mode: Built-in imagegen; no CLI or separate image API
why: 0.4.3 corrected the legs and hands by stretching the drawn art with rig-side width bands. That distorts the drawing: the calves came out warped and the garter looked like a tourniquet. The bands are gone; the shapes are redrawn instead.

assets.fixes: Legs too thin throughout, ribbed warmer cuff as wide as the fabric below it, garter strap lying flat on the thigh with no reaction
Hand far too large for a child; redrawn at 63 percent with the wrist fixed

postProcess: Both keyed with the cutout tool and recomposited over each texture's own chroma value; subject pixels untouched

legRowWidths.note: Sample 6 is the ribbed cuff, deliberately narrower than the reference sample because the cuff now grips the calf

open: sleeve-right-v6 was not generated: the Codex workspace ran out of credits mid-run. The right hand is still the 0.4.2 drawing, held to size by the pre-existing wrist scale (0.76 instead of 0.87). Redraw it the same way as the left when credits are back.
